title: Abide with Me (SATB closed score, chromatic)

expected.notes: Closed score: Soprano+Alto share the treble staff, Tenor+Bass the bass staff; a correct conversion outputs FOUR parts (Soprano, Alto, Tenor, Bass) with the two verses of lyrics on the Soprano.  Eb major, pickup + 12 bars, chromatic harmony: A natural (F7), Cb (Ab minor), E natural (C7), F# (D7), B natural (G7), Db (Eb7) and a German sixth (Cb-Eb-Gb-A) in bar 8.  Bar 2: the alto A4 natural on beat 2 also governs the soprano A4 on beat 4, which therefore has NO printed natural on the shared staff (the split Soprano part must still be A natural).  Bar 7: the alto F4 on beat 4 carries a natural on the shared staff only because the soprano sang F#4 on beat 3.  On a shared staff an accidental binds BOTH voices for the rest of the bar (LilyPond default, same octave only), so some notes of one voice carry no sign because the other voice already altered that pitch (listed in shared_staff_accidental_differences); the split parts must still get the altered pitch.  Some cancellations in the bar after an alteration are shown as parenthesised courtesy accidentals, others are left to the barline rule (courtesy_accidentals).

truth_limitations: The truth encodes separate parts, so <accidental> elements are those a correct per-part transcription displays; on the engraved shared staves a few printed accidentals differ (see shared_staff_accidental_differences).  Pitches are identical either way.
